findings.issue: 空く in the idiom お腹が空く ('to get hungry') is read すく, not あく (あく = 'to become vacant/open', e.g. 席が空いた). Correct phonetics: おなかがすいた.
Reading of 空い in お腹が空いた is すい (from 空く・すく 'stomach empties'), not あい. あく does not apply to hunger.
Romaji mirrors the wrong reading あいた; should reflect すいた (onaka ga suita).
何 directly before the object particle を is read なに, not なん (なん appears only before だ/の/counters/t-d-n sounds). 何をしていた = なにをしていた.
findings.current: あそこでなんをしていたの?
findings.suggested: あそこでなにをしていたの?

findings.issue: 何 before を must be glossed with reading なに in this context; なん is wrong here.
Romaji mirrors the wrong reading なん (and drops the object particle vowel); with なにを it should read nani o.
何 directly before を is read なに, not なん. 何を表わしていますか = なにをあらわしていますか.
findings.current: ゆーえぬというのわなんをあらわしていますか。
findings.suggested: ゆーえぬというのわなにをあらわしていますか。

findings.issue: Token 何 before を must read なに in this sentence; なん is wrong.
Romaji mirrors the wrong なん reading; should be nani o arawashite imasu ka.
我 in the set expression 我の強い ('self-willed', JMdict: 我の強い【がのつよい】, cf. 我が強い ががつよい) is read が, not われ (archaic pronoun 'I').
findings.current: あいつわわれのつよいやつだ。
findings.suggested: あいつわがのつよいやつだ。

findings.issue: 我 meaning 'ego/self-will' in 我の強い／我が強い is read が; われ is the pronoun sense and wrong in this expression.
Romaji mirrors the wrong われ reading; should be ga no tsuyoi.
This あ is the first mora of あした 'tomorrow' (as token し's note and the expl themselves state), not an interjection; glossing it as 'ah' teaches a false parse of the sentence.
findings.current: ah (interjection; here it reinforces the wish, together with なあ)
findings.suggested: tomorrow (first part of あした; mis-segmented token)

findings.issue: Same defect as the en gloss: this あ is part of あした 'amanhã', not an interjection; contradicts the note on the following token and the expl.
findings.current: ah (interjeição; aqui reforça o desejo, junto de なあ)
findings.suggested: amanhã (parte de あした; token mal segmentado)

findings.issue: In 我の強いやつ, 我 is the subject of the attributive clause 我の強い (の substitutes が inside relative clauses); the modified nucleus is やつ, not 我. The role inverts the structure.
findings.suggested: sujeito da oração adjetiva 我の強い (の = が)
